## History

Harmon Andrews is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). Along with Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and the girls, he attends the event, where he successfully wins a second-place prize for his fall apples.
